message.content:
**Alex** wins.  
With only the two hole cards available, the hand rankings are:

| Player | Hand | Rank |
|--------|------|------|
| Alex   | A♠ K♠ (Ace‑King suited) | Highest |
| Robert | Q♥ 10♥ (Queen‑Ten suited) | Lower |
| Steve  | 4♠ 5♠ (Four‑Five suited) | Lower |
| Sam    | 2♦ 3♣ (Two‑Three unsuited) | Lowest |

Since Alex holds the highest possible two‑card combination (Ace‑King), he comes out on top.
